_note: 阶段 2 草稿：动物园 + 玩具 20 词。确认后合并进 content/words.json。

themes.scene: a sunny zoo: plain sky-blue sky with two flat white rounded clouds, a simple yellow sun, a few round green bushes and one tall palm-like tree at the edges, a low simple wooden fence along the far horizon, wide flat sandy-green ground

a cozy kids' playroom: a soft mint wall with a round window showing blue sky, a simple low shelf and an open wooden toy box at the far right edge, a large plain warm-cream rug covering the bottom part of the floor

words.art: a chubby yellow lion cub sitting, round fluffy orange mane like a sun around its face, tiny tail with a tuft
words.tip: 玩“小狮子”：双手当爪子说 Roar! 让孩子也 Roar，再轻声说 A little lion!

words.art: a round orange tiger cub sitting, three short dark brown stripes on its forehead only, white muzzle, little round ears
words.tip: 看绘本时比较狮子和老虎：Lion or tiger? 让孩子指一指。

words.art: a chubby light grey baby elephant standing, big round ears, short trunk curled up happily

en.say: Toot! The elephant has a long nose.

words.tip: 把手臂放在鼻子前当象鼻甩一甩：I'm an elephant! Toot!

words.art: a round brown monkey sitting, cream face and ears, long curly tail, one hand raised waving

en.say: Ooh ooh, ah ah! The monkey says hi.

words.tip: 吃香蕉时说：Monkeys love bananas! Ooh ooh, ah ah!

words.art: a chubby brown bear cub sitting, round ears, light tan muzzle and round tummy patch
words.tip: 睡前给孩子一个大熊抱：Big bear hug!

words.art: a chubby white panda cub sitting, black round ears, black oval eye patches, black arms and legs, holding one short green bamboo stick

en.say: Munch munch. The panda eats bamboo.

words.tip: 看到黑白相间的东西就问：Like a panda? Black and white!

words.art: a cute yellow baby giraffe standing, long neck, a few big round soft brown spots, two tiny horn knobs

en.say: So tall! The giraffe is tall.

words.tip: 把孩子举高高：So tall! Like a giraffe!

words.art: a chubby white baby zebra standing, only four thick simple black stripes on its body, short black mane
words.tip: 过斑马线时说：Look! Zebra stripes!

words.art: a friendly round-faced green snake coiled in a soft S shape, head raised, small curved smile
words.tip: 用手臂扭来扭去：Wiggle like a snake! Hiss!

words.art: a round green frog sitting, big round eyes on top of its head, wide smile, light green tummy
words.tip: 蹲下来一起跳：Jump like a frog! Ribbit!

words.art: a round bouncy ball in two halves, coral red and sunny yellow, no face
words.tip: 滚球给孩子：Catch the ball! 孩子滚回来再说 Thank you!

words.art: a small round toy car seen from the side, sky blue body, two round windows, two black wheels, no face

en.say: Beep beep! The car goes vroom.

words.tip: 路上看到车：Look, a car! Beep beep!

words.art: a short chunky toy train engine seen from the side, red body, yellow roof, round chimney with one small white puff cloud, black wheels, no face

en.say: Choo choo! The train goes choo choo.

words.tip: 排队搭着肩开小火车：Choo choo! All aboard!

words.art: a small round toy sailboat, coral red hull, one white triangle sail, no water, no face

en.say: Splash! The boat goes on the water.

words.tip: 洗澡时放个小玩具漂：A boat! Splash!

words.art: a chubby toy airplane seen from the side, white body, sky blue wings and tail, round windows, no face

en.say: Zoom! The plane flies up high.

words.tip: 抱起孩子“飞”一圈：Zoom! I'm a plane!

words.art: a simple soft rag doll standing, round face with bean eyes and pink cheeks, short brown yarn hair, pink dress
words.tip: 玩过家家：Give the doll some milk.

words.art: a soft cuddly honey-colored teddy bear sitting, round ears, cream muzzle, small red bow at the neck
words.tip: 睡前：Night night, teddy! 让孩子抱着说。

words.art: three chunky toy building blocks stacked into a small tower, red, yellow and blue cubes, no letters, no face

en.say: Up, up, up! Build with blocks.

words.tip: 搭积木一边数：Up, up, up! 倒了就说 Uh-oh!

words.art: a chunky children's picture book lying open, cover green, plain pages with a simple drawn sun shape, no letters, no face
words.tip: 读绘本前说：Let's read a book! 翻页时说 Turn the page.

words.art: one round pink balloon with a small knot and a short curly string, no face
words.tip: 吹气球让孩子拍：Up, up, balloon!
